The truly outstanding runs of the 1990 event were the 2 fast long leg efforts by Gary Staines (pulling through the field) and Paul Evans (front running in probably the best effort of the day). John Gladwin ran 4th fastest short leg while Justin Chaston was just a gnat's tickle behind.

Paul Evans astounded everyone by running the fastest long leg by a 20 sec. margin while Andy Lloyd made a welcome return to finish 2nd fastest on the short leg followed by Justin Chaston 3rd fastest and a somewhat surprised Stuart Paton in 6th fastest place on the short leg.
Darren Mead was a fine winner of thr Junior title. Justin Chaston was well positioned in 25th place. Our only representative in the Senior race was Olly Foote who finished 240th.
